title: Fix-first: regenerate the impact registry after slice 1 added a suite
action: FIX-FIRST cell for a red found by the slice-1 feature verify. The full run is 116/117 green; the single failure is scripts/tests/test_impact_registry.mjs:177 -- 'the committed registry has drifted from a fresh build'. Root cause: the slice plan required node scripts/impact_registry.mjs --write only in bfr-1, but bfr-3 afterwards ADDED a new suite (scripts/tests/test_instruction_size_law.mjs), which changes run_verify.mjs's live SUITES and therefore the derived registry. Any cell that adds or removes a suite owes the regen. Do TWO things, IN THIS ORDER. (1) In scripts/tests/test_instruction_size_law.mjs remove the dead binding at :220, const realRootText = fs.readFileSync(REAL_ROOT_AGENTS_PATH, ...) -- it is never read, because the fixture derives its root AGENTS.md from the template via renderRootAgents() rather than copying the real root. Remove REAL_ROOT_AGENTS_PATH too IF AND ONLY IF nothing else references it; check first, do not assume. Change nothing else in that file: its two invariants and three negative controls are correct and their behavior must be unchanged. (2) THEN run node scripts/impact_registry.mjs --write, after the edit, so the regenerated registry reflects the final file. Order matters -- regenerating before the edit leaves it stale again.
